name.value: Burnaby Cariboo RV Park and Campground Vancouver

description.value: A well-maintained urban RV park in Burnaby with an indoor pool, hot tub, and fitness centre, a 10–12 minute walk from SkyTrain and about 30 minutes from downtown Vancouver; tent sites are available but the setting is a paved RV lot and open fires are prohibited by city bylaw.

raw_osm.name: Burnaby Cariboo RV Park and Campground Vancouver

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at bcrvpark.com is fully accessible and confirms the OSM record. The FAQs page explicitly lists amenities including laundry, free Wi-Fi, indoor pool and hot tub, and showers are confirmed by the park rules page ('Children under 10 years of age shall not operate showers'). The contact page confirms the phone number +1 (604) 420-1722 matches OSM. One notable discrepancy: OSM assigns this record to 'North Vancouver' but the postal code V3N and the website consistently state the park is in Burnaby.
concerns: OSM community field is 'North Vancouver' but the park is in Burnaby per postal code V3N and consistent website references — OSM community assignment appears incorrect.
OSM name appends 'Vancouver' to the name ('Burnaby Cariboo RV Park and Campground Vancouver') while the website uses 'Burnaby Cariboo RV Park' or 'BCRV Park + Campground' without 'Vancouver'.
No explicit mention of tent camping or hiker/biker sites; the property appears primarily oriented toward self-contained RVs with full hook-ups.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a well-established, high-amenity campground with strong utility for urban cycle tourists, but the website markets it almost exclusively as an RV park with full hook-up sites; whether walk-in or hiker/biker tent sites are available for cycle tourists is not confirmed anywhere in the website content.
enrichment_extras.notes: Park email (camping@bcrvpark.com) found on contact page but not present in OSM tags.

wow_evidence: indoor pool, hot tub, and fitness centre
